key_insight: Adding convex physical priors to POPS-Regression enables misspecification-aware uncertainty estimates while enforcing specified physical properties across the model ensemble.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce the need for costly additional training data to correct physical failures in interatomic potentials designed for specific applications.
method: Extend POPS-Regression with physical constraints expressible as convex sets of model parameters.
Enforce these constraints across the uncertainty ensemble.
Apply to linear potentials and fixed-feature linear readouts of message-passing neural networks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports demonstrations involving phononic vibrations and elastic properties for both linear and message-passing neural network potentials, without quantitative performance metrics.
watch_item: Guarantees cover only specified convex physical constraints; the neural-network treatment fixes nonlinear features and approximates the readout as linear.
paper_title: Physics Informed Priors for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials with Uncertainty Quantification
